name: Denver Ham & Cheese Crustless Egg Bake

fit.band: 449 cal in 400-650 band; 7 g carbs under the 35 g cap; no seafood; crustless no-starch oven bake, 8-serving weigh-and-divide scales cleanly to 14; budget meal-prep dinner. Clears every condition.

catalog_check: NOT a live-catalog duplicate. Catalog has no egg-bound ham casserole: the nearest, 'Ham and Potato Cheddar Casserole' (ham-and-potato-cheddar-casserole), carries NO eggs and is a russet-potato/cheddar gratin -- different binder and starch base entirely, a different dinner. Denver here is a 12-egg + cheddar + half-and-half custard bound to diced ham + bell peppers + onions + mushrooms (Western/Denver-omelet flavor), a plate the catalog does not have.
accepted_slugs_check: Read fresh. Distinct from accepted crustless-bacon-gruyere-quiche: different cured pork (ham vs bacon), different cheese (cheddar vs gruyere), and a defining Denver/Western vegetable load (peppers + onions + mushrooms) that the plain gruyere quiche lacks -- different flavor family, not a dupe. NOTE the pool's crustless-ham-gruyere-quiche was DUPE'd into crustless-bacon-gruyere-quiche (both gruyere, no veg); this Denver bake is NOT that dish -- cheddar, not gruyere, and Denver-veg-forward, so it survives that collision.
pool_collisions_same_protein: No same-protein pool twin found among adjudicated candidates: this is the only ham/Denver egg bake in the pork pool, so it widens the egg-bake sub-catalog with a distinct flavor rather than crowding the sausage-broccoli-cheddar cluster. It shares only the generic crustless-egg-custard FORMAT with that cluster and with accepted crustless-bacon-gruyere-quiche -- different protein and flavor, not a dupe.
cross_protein_collisions: The egg-cheddar custard is the identity and ham is a swappable component, so a Denver/Western crustless egg bake made with turkey ham, or any ham-and-cheese crustless egg bake, in another selector's pool would be the SAME plate. Decider should watch turkey/chicken lanes for a Denver/Western or ham-and-cheese crustless egg-bake twin. Also, tally the overall crustless-egg-bake family across proteins (accepted crustless-bacon-gruyere-quiche + the sausage-broccoli-cheddar cluster + this) so the catalog is not overweight on egg bakes even though each is individually distinct.
note_to_decider: Clean KEEP. Fits every condition (449 cal / 7 g carbs), clears live catalog and accepted-slugs, board maps cleanly (zero unmapped -- a good pricer-lane control), and is the most differentiated crustless egg bake in the pork pool (distinct Denver/Western flavor, no same-protein twin). Prefer this over any redundant sausage-broccoli-cheddar cluster instance if slots are tight.
